Borrowing power calculator

Borrowing power calculator

This calculator provides a quick estimate of how much you may be able to borrow based on the income and expenses entered. It also displays the home loan repayment amount based on either the AMP Essential or Professional Package home loan. A different AMP Bank home loan product can be selected, or you can manually select the interest rate.
